verses.text: A Mikhtam of David. Preserve me, O God, for I take refuge in You.
verses.textZh: （大衛的金詩。）神啊，求你保佑我，因為我投靠你。

verses.text: I said to the LORD, 'You are my Lord; I have no good besides You.'
verses.textZh: 我的心哪，你曾對耶和華說：你是我的主；我的好處不在你以外。

verses.text: As for the saints who are in the earth, They are the majestic ones in whom is all my delight.
verses.textZh: 論到世上的聖民，他們又美又善，是我最喜悅的。

verses.text: The sorrows of those who have bartered for another [god] will be multiplied; I shall not pour out their drink offerings of blood, Nor will I take their names upon my lips.
verses.textZh: 以別神代替耶和華的（或譯：送禮物給別　神的），他們的愁苦必加增；他們所澆奠的血我不獻上；我嘴唇也不提別　神的名號。

verses.text: The LORD is the portion of my inheritance and my cup; You support my lot.
verses.textZh: 耶和華是我的產業，是我杯中的分；我所得的，你為我持守。

verses.text: The lines have fallen to me in pleasant places; Indeed, my heritage is beautiful to me.
verses.textZh: 用繩量給我的地界，坐落在佳美之處；我的產業實在美好。

verses.text: I will bless the LORD who has counseled me; Indeed, my mind instructs me in the night.
verses.textZh: 我必稱頌那指教我的耶和華；我的心腸在夜間也警戒我。

verses.text: I have set the LORD continually before me; Because He is at my right hand, I will not be shaken.
verses.textZh: 我將耶和華常擺在我面前，因他在我右邊，我便不致搖動。

verses.text: Therefore my heart is glad and my glory rejoices; My flesh also will dwell securely.
verses.textZh: 因此，我的心歡喜，我的靈（原文是榮耀）快樂；我的肉身也要安然居住。

verses.text: For You will not abandon my soul to Sheol; Nor will You allow Your Holy One to undergo decay.
verses.textZh: 因為你必不將我的靈魂撇在陰間，也不叫你的聖者見朽壞。

verses.text: You will make known to me the path of life; In Your presence is fullness of joy; In Your right hand there are pleasures forever.
verses.textZh: 你必將生命的道路指示我。在你面前有滿足的喜樂；在你右手中有永遠的福樂。
